note: Tolerances for evals/gate.py. 'metrics': a gated metric fails only when the lower bound of the 95% bootstrap CI of the paired worsening (new vs reference, paired per (host, case, rep), repetitions averaged per case, CI over cases) is above 'tolerance' in the metric's own unit; worse than tolerance on average with a CI that reaches back inside it is a warning. 'absolute': the one rule without statistics, because any occurrence is a defect: the share of reader-facing runs whose output carries an unresolved marker or placeholder. 'min_cases_for_ci': fewer paired cases than this give no verdict. Tolerances of flesch_reading_ease (5) and sentence_length_cv (0.1) sit above the A/A noise floor measured with `gate.py aa` on v-voice-omp and v-clean-omp (largest per-skill lower CI bound of a pure repetition swap: 4.2 points, 0.083); re-measure when the reference changes. Flow and duplication metrics (METRICS_VERSION 2): a metric is gated only when it passes evals/flow_validation.py on v-iso-omp (order sensitivity where it reads sentence order: a sentence-shuffled copy scores worse in most reader runs with the CI lower bound above 0.5; and agreement with the blind judge: the share of judged pairs where the metric prefers the judge's winner has a bootstrap CI lower bound above 0.5). None of the new metrics passed, so all are 'gated': false with the measured reason; their tolerances are about twice the A/A floor (largest lower CI bound of a pure repetition swap on v-iso-omp) so that switching one on later starts above rerun noise.

invented_facts.why: A/A on v-iso-omp (single rep r1 vs r3) gave a CI lower bound of +0.024 per run for ALL; 0.05 clears that floor and still catches the v-clean project-report regression (+0.056)

sentence_length_cv.why: info-only: agrees with the blind judge's preference below chance on v-iso-omp (0.38 [0.29, 0.48]), so more variation is not evidence of better writing

adjacent_cohesion.why: info-only, not validated against readers (evals/flow_validation.py on v-iso-omp): fails order sensitivity (shuffled copies worse in 61% of reader runs, CI [0.46, 0.73], lower bound not above 0.5); judge agreement 0.48 [0.34, 0.61] over 145 pairs

abrupt_jump_rate.why: gated as the flow measure: it detects broken order (a sentence-shuffled copy scores worse in 78% [0.70, 0.85] of reader outputs on v-iso-omp); it does not predict the judge's overall preference (0.51 [0.36, 0.65]), so it guards flow, not quality; tolerance about twice the A/A floor

given_new_carry.why: gated as the flow measure: shuffled copies score worse in 70% [0.59, 0.80] of reader outputs on v-iso-omp; judge agreement 0.50 [0.37, 0.64], so it guards flow, not quality; tolerance about twice the A/A floor
